**Frame id and axis**

**The trap it attacks** (T1 to T8)

**The stance** (second person, one paragraph, the instruction the branch runs under)

**What it forbids** (at least two items; a frame that forbids nothing is not a distortion)

**A problem where it diverges from every existing frame** (this becomes a fixture)

**Which existing frame is closest, and why this is not that frame in different words**
